message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and merges dataframes without any schema checks, dtype assertions, null-count guards, or value-range validations on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local file paths (pd.read_csv with local conf.data_path / conf.external_path); there are no remote fetches, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any file.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values, comparison of label distributions, or use of any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing pipeline performs feature engineering and fillna but includes no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded via `model.load_model(conf.model_path + conf.model_name)` and a pickle file is loaded with `pickle.load(f)` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check.

No detected label distribution validation: The training code reads the CSV and proceeds directly to preprocessing and model fitting without any check on label distribution, class balance, or anomalous target values.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger detection mechanism in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard XGBoost training without any differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any stress-test logic are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The validation split uses a simple random train_test_split on the same preprocessed dataframe (including target-encoded features fitted on the full training set), so the held-out set is not fully isolated from training; there is no signing, hashing, or use of multiple independent metrics.
No detected input sanitization: The predict() method reads CSV data and calls preprocessing/fillna(0) but performs no schema validation, shape checks, or range checks on incoming inference inputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses an XGBoost tabular regression model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
